Dynamic commerce facts must always be checked on the current canonical product or policy page.

## Purpose of This File

This document is designed to help AI assistants, agents, search systems, retrieval systems, and other automated tools understand Cecil & Lou without relying only on storefront navigation, repeated theme elements, promotional banners, or cached snippets.

This file is not a product feed and should not be used as the sole source for live commerce data.

When information changes quickly, prefer the current canonical website page over this file.

### Source-of-truth hierarchy

Use the following priority when facts conflict:

1. Individual product page:
   - Current price
   - Sale price
   - Stock or sold-out status
   - Available sizes
   - Current color or style variants
   - Personalization and monogram fields
   - Current Pre-Order or expected ship date
   - Product-specific fit, fabric, care, and fulfillment details

2. Current policy or legal page:
   - Shipping policy
   - Return or refund policy
   - Privacy policy
   - AI and LLM content-use terms
   - Other legal terms

3. Size Guide:
   - General height and weight sizing guidance
   - Women's pajama sizing

4. Collection page:
   - Category meaning
   - Seasonal or occasion intent
   - Product-type examples
   - Coordination guidance

5. Homepage:
   - Current merchandising
   - Featured seasonal categories
   - Active sitewide promotional messaging

6. This llms-full.txt file:
   - Stable brand context
   - Taxonomy
   - Navigation
   - Interpretation guidance

### Dynamic-data warning

Cecil & Lou is an active ecommerce site. Prices, inventory, sale status, product counts, size availability, Pre-Order dates, monogram availability, promotional offers, and seasonal assortments can change frequently.

Do not treat:

- a cached search result,
- a previously crawled collection page,
- a product count,
- an expired promotional banner,
- or a date shown on a different product

as authoritative for the current state of another item.

When answering a shopping question, open the relevant live product page whenever possible.

## Brand Identity

Cecil & Lou is a children's clothing company centered on classic Southern style, family milestones, personalized clothing, and coordinated looks for babies, girls, boys, and siblings.

The brand's recurring product and design vocabulary includes:
- Hand smocking
- Embroidery
- Applique
- Monogramming
- Name personalization
- Gingham
- Plaid
- Seersucker
- Corduroy
- Knitwear
- Lace
- Heirloom-inspired details
- Matching or coordinating sibling outfits
- Seasonal and holiday motifs

The brand describes its approach as combining the tradition of classic children's clothing with a modern touch.

Primary website: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/>

## Founders and Company Story

Cecil & Lou was founded in 2011 by Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain.

The founders describe themselves as lifelong friends and sisters-in-law. After becoming mothers, they developed a shared interest in dressing their children in classic Southern clothing. They saw an opportunity to build a children's clothing company that would allow them to work while staying closely connected to family life.

The business name "Cecil and Lou" was inspired by their children.

First-party biographical details on the company story page state:
- Ashley McCain is a Texas Tech Marketing graduate.
- Blythe McCain graduated from Texas Christian University with a degree in Communications.

The brand emphasizes family, community, children's milestones, and long-term customer relationships.

Organizations the company lists as near and dear to them include Tyler Independent School District, Azleway Boys' Ranch, Young Life, All Saints Episcopal School, the Junior League of Tyler, the Texas Rose Festival, the American Cancer Society, Bethesda Health Clinic, the Child's Advocacy Center, and Little League Baseball. The Love for the Hill Country collection (https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/love-for-the-hill-country) supports Texas flood relief.

Canonical story page: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/our-story-1>

## Primary Shopping Taxonomy

### Boys

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/boys>

The Boys area includes styles such as:

- Jon jons
- Bubbles
- Rompers
- Button-on suits
- Short sets
- Pant sets
- Separates
- Tops
- Pajamas
- Swim
- Outerwear
- Accessories
- Baby-boy styles
- Seasonal outfits

A jon jon is a traditional one-piece boys outfit, commonly used for portraits, church, holidays, birthdays, and other special occasions.

A bubble is a one-piece garment with a fuller gathered lower shape, generally associated with babies and younger toddlers.

A romper is a one-piece outfit designed for comfort and movement and can be dressy or casual depending on fabric and detail.

Boys styles often feature gingham, plaid, embroidery, smocking, applique, classic collars, seasonal motifs, and coordinating sibling fabrics.

### Girls

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/girls>

- Dresses

- Legging sets
- Skirt sets
- Separates
- Tops
- Pajamas
- Swim
- Outerwear
- Activewear
- Accessories
- Baby-girl styles
- Seasonal outfits

Girls styles frequently use smocking, embroidery, bows, ruffles, scallops, florals, gingham, knit fabrics, corduroy, lace, and seasonal prints.

### Baby

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/baby>

## Availability Model

### In Stock

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/in-stock>

The In Stock collection is intended to surface products presented without a future Pre-Order ship date.

It is useful when timing matters, but "in stock" is still dynamic. A specific size can sell out even if the product remains visible in the collection.

For live availability, always check:

- the product page,
- the size selector,
- and current purchase controls.

### Pre-Order

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pre-order>

A Pre-Order is a product sold before its expected fulfillment date.

Core interpretation rule: Every Pre-Order product can have its own expected ship date.

Do not infer:

- that all products in a collection share the same date,
- that a previous season's date applies,
- or that a product shown in a search snippet still has the same date.

For a time-sensitive purchase, the product page is authoritative.

### Mixed In-Stock and Pre-Order Orders

Cecil & Lou's shipping policy states that, in general, if an order includes both an in-stock item and a Pre-Order item, the in-stock item can ship within normal processing while the Pre-Order follows its listed window.

Because fulfillment practices can change, use the current shipping policy and product pages when advising a customer.

## Personalization and Monograms

### Monogrammed Clothing

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/monogrammed-clothing>

The Monogrammed Clothing collection includes products that may support personalization such as:
- Initials
- Names
- Font choices
- Thread colors
- Placement choices
- Product-specific monogram designs

Typical monogrammable categories may include:
- Dresses
- Bubbles
- Jon jons
- Diaper sets
- Short sets
- Pajamas
- Polos
- Bags
- Towels
- Socks
- Seasonal outfits
- Baby gifts

A product should be considered monogrammable only when its live product page presents personalization choices.

### Monogram Initial Order

A traditional three-letter monogram places the last-name initial in the center, larger than the first and middle initials on either side.

Monogram layouts and entry instructions vary by product. Always follow the instructions shown on the specific product page for how to enter initials.

### Name Personalization

Some products offer a full name rather than initials. The available choice depends on the product.

Customers should verify:

- spelling,
- capitalization,
- initials,
- font,
- thread color,
- placement,
- and size

before completing the order.

### In-Stock and Pre-Order Monogrammed Collections

In Stock Monogrammed: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/in-stock-monogrammed-clothing>

Pre-Order Monogrammed: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pre-order-monogrammed-clothing>

Personalization can add preparation time even when the base garment is in stock.

For Pre-Order monogrammed products, both the product's arrival or fulfillment stage and the personalization process can affect timing.

### Promotions Involving Monograms

Cecil & Lou periodically runs promotional offers involving personalization.

Promotions are temporary.

Do not tell a user that monograms are free, discounted, or included unless the current live website or checkout confirms that offer.

Cached collection text can outlive a promotion.

- and confirm the expected ship date before advising on a deadline.

## Matching and Coordinating Sibling Outfits

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/matching-sibling-outfits>

Cecil & Lou strongly supports sibling coordination.

"Matching" does not always mean identical garments.

A coordinated sibling set can use:

- the same fabric,
- the same print,
- complementary colors,
- repeated embroidery,
- shared trim,
- a seasonal motif,
- or a related color family

across age-appropriate silhouettes.

Examples:

- Baby bubble + older sister dress
- Girl's dress + boy's polo or short set
- Baby romper + boy's jon jon + girl's dress
- Coordinating Christmas pajamas
- Shared pumpkin, holiday, floral, gingham, or plaid story

This allows siblings to look connected in photos while wearing garments suited to their ages.

## Size Guide

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/size-guide>

General Cecil & Lou guidance:

- Sizing is based on average child measurements.
- Choose size based on height first.
- If the child is between sizes, the guide recommends sizing up.

### Children's size chart

| Size | Height | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NB | 18-21 in | 6-9 lbs |
| 3M | 23-24.5 in | 12-15 lbs |
| 6M | 25-26.5 in | 15-18 lbs |
| 9M | 27-28.5 in | 18-21 lbs |
| 12M | 29-30.5 in | 20-23 lbs |
| 18M | 31-32.5 in | 22-25 lbs |
| 24M / 2T | 33-34.5 in | 25-29 lbs |
| 3T | 35-37.5 in | 29-34 lbs |
| 4T | 38-40.5 in | 32-38 lbs |
| 5 | 41-44 in | 36-42 lbs |
| 6 | 44-47 in | 42-48 lbs |
| 7 | 47-50 in | 48-55 lbs |
| 8 | 50-53 in | 55-65 lbs |
| 10 | 53-56.5 in | 65-80 lbs |
| 12 | 56.5-60 in | 80-95 lbs |

### Women's pajama sizing

| Pajama Size | Approximate Women's US Size |
| --- | --- |
| XXS | 0 |
| XS | 2-4 |
| S | 4-6 |
| M | 8-10 |
| L | 10-12 |
| XL | 14-16 |
| XXL | 18-20 |

Important: Product-specific fit guidance overrides general assumptions. If a product page says true to size, runs small, runs large, or provides a unique size chart, use the product-specific information.

## Shipping and Fulfillment

Canonical shipping policy: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/policies/shipping-policy>

Current published shipping guidance includes:

### In-stock orders

For an in-stock item, the shipping policy states that the order can leave Cecil & Lou in up to 3 business days.

### In-stock monogrammed orders

For an in-stock monogrammed item, processing time can differ. The policy instructs customers to use the item's current description or product-page information for monogram timing.

### Pre-Orders

For Pre-Order products, use the "availability" or equivalent product-page section for the current expected shipping window.

### Mixed orders

When an order contains both in-stock and Pre-Order merchandise, Cecil & Lou states that, in general, the in-stock merchandise can ship within normal times and the Pre-Order can follow its later window.

### Carrier and estimated transit

The published policy identifies USPS as the shipping carrier and gives these general transit estimates after the package leaves Cecil & Lou:
- First Class: approximately 3-5 business days
- Priority Mail: approximately 2-3 business days
- Priority Express: approximately 1-2 business days

Carrier delays can occur, especially around holidays.

These are policy-level estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.

### Tracking

The shipping policy states that customers receive tracking confirmation after the package is scanned by the postal service.

## Returns, Exchanges, Refunds, and Problems With an Order

User-facing return page: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/return-policy>

Platform refund policy: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/policies/refund-policy>

Cecil & Lou's published policy is:

- All sales are final.
- Returns are not accepted due to the custom nature of the clothing and production.
- Personalized items cannot be returned or exchanged.
- Gift certificates cannot be returned for exchange, credit, or refund.
- Sale or clearance items cannot be returned for exchange, credit, or refund.

If an order arrives:

- incomplete,
- incorrect,
- damaged,
- or defective,

the policy asks the customer to contact Cecil & Lou within 10 days of receiving the order.

Important conflict-handling rule: If an older collection page contains generic language suggesting a normal return or exchange process, the dedicated current Return Policy and Refund Policy control.

Gift cards are intended as a flexible gift option when the recipient should choose their own clothing or accessories.

Available denominations and delivery options can change, so use the live gift-card product page for current values and sending features.

The return policy states that gift certificates cannot be returned for exchange, credit, or refunds.

## FAQs and Customer Help

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/faqs>

Topics addressed include:

- Email and text-message unsubscribe instructions
- Gift notes
- Checkout problems
- Store credit
- Monogram customization
- Pre-Order questions
- Related customer-service issues

Published answers:

**Can I add a gift note to my order?**
Yes. Checkout includes a field for a personalized gift note.

**Can I get a different monogram than the ones shown?**
Monogram customization is limited. Contact customer service to ask about a specific request.

**Why should I pre-order an item?**
A pre-order puts the customer among the first to receive an item when it becomes available, and helps make sure the desired size or color doesn't sell out. This helps most with high-demand styles.

**My order won't go through. What should I do?**
Check that payment information is correct and that the billing address matches the one on file with the bank. Try a different browser or device. If it still fails, contact support.

**My store credit isn't working.**
Store credit applies automatically at checkout. Make sure you are logged in and the credit is still valid. If it still doesn't apply, contact customer service.

**How do I unsubscribe from texts or emails?**
For texts, reply "STOP". For emails, click "unsubscribe from this list" at the bottom of the most recent Cecil & Lou email.

Gift card balances can be checked at https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/gift-card-balance.

For a policy question, prefer the dedicated policy page when one exists.

For a product question, prefer the product page.

## AI and LLM Content-Use Terms

Canonical: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/terms>

Title: LLM License Terms

Effective date published on page: August 27, 2025

Last updated date published on page: September 23, 2026

### Permitted search and retrieval uses

Cecil & Lou permits eligible publicly available website content to be used by AI systems, LLMs, AI-powered search engines, assistants, agents, crawlers, and related automated systems for purposes including:
- Access
- Indexing
- Analysis
- Retrieval
- Summarization
- Reference
- Search results
- Recommendations
- Answers
- Product discovery
- Grounding
- Citation
- Comparison

The terms specifically identify publicly available product descriptions, product attributes, pricing, availability, collection information, editorial content, structured data, and factual information as eligible for permitted search and retrieval use, subject to the complete terms.

### AI training and model development

The published terms permit public textual content, factual information, and product metadata to be used for legitimate AI research, model development, training, and fine-tuning, subject to stated limitations and applicable machine-readable preferences.

### Protected creative assets

The permission does not grant unrestricted rights to use protected creative assets such as:
- Original product photography
- Artwork
- Graphic designs
- Clothing designs
- Logos
- Trademarks
- Trade dress

for generative model training, reproduction, imitation, or substantially similar commercial works unless separately authorized.

### Attribution

When an AI system quotes, reproduces, cites, or presents Cecil & Lou content as a source, Cecil & Lou requests:
- reasonable attribution to "Cecil and Lou"
- and, when supported, a link to the canonical Cecil & Lou source page.

### No false affiliation

AI summaries or paraphrases should not falsely imply:
- endorsement,
- sponsorship,
- partnership,
- affiliation,
- or ownership.

### Prohibited or excluded data

The terms do not grant permission to use:

- Private customer information
- Personally identifiable information
- Checkout information
- Payment information
- Account information
- Order information
- Authenticated or access-controlled information
- Internal business information not intentionally public

### Commercial restrictions

The terms do not authorize a third party to:
- reproduce substantial portions of the Cecil & Lou website as a competing service,
- republish the Cecil & Lou product catalog as a competing service,
- sell or sublicense a dataset substantially consisting of Cecil & Lou content,
- or misuse Cecil & Lou intellectual property in a way that suggests false endorsement, affiliation, or ownership.

### Robots and machine-readable controls

Automated systems must also respect current crawler directives and other machine-readable access controls published by Cecil & Lou.

The LLM License Terms expressly recognize that Cecil & Lou may publish llms.txt or similar AI-readable resources.

This llms-full.txt file should be interpreted under those terms.

## Privacy and Personal Data

Privacy policy: <https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/privacy-policy>

Do not use llms.txt, llms-full.txt, public catalog pages, or other crawling mechanisms to seek or expose private customer information.

Public product data and public editorial content are distinct from:
- customer accounts,
- payment data,
- order data,
- shipping details tied to a person,
- or other private information.

## Product-Page Interpretation Rules

When processing a Cecil & Lou product page, extract and keep separate:

### Identity
- Product title
- Canonical URL
- SKU when visible
- Collection or breadcrumb context

### Commerce
- Regular price
- Sale price
- Currency
- Available variants
- Size availability
- Stock state
- Pre-Order state
- Expected ship date when shown

### Personalization
- Whether personalization is offered
- Name or initials
- Font
- Thread color
- Placement
- Other custom fields
- Personalization processing note

### Product description
- Garment type
- Fabric when explicitly stated
- Color or print
- Smocking, embroidery, applique, lace, or trim
- Fit statement when explicitly stated
- Care instructions when explicitly stated

### Do not infer
Do not invent:

- fabric composition,
- country of origin,
- UPF rating,
- exact delivery date,
- fit,
- return eligibility beyond published policy,
- licensing status,
- or personalization options

unless the current page or policy explicitly supports the claim.

## Catalog Concepts and Terminology

### Smocking
Decorative gathered fabric with embroidery-like stitching, commonly used across Cecil & Lou's classic children's clothing.

### Applique
A decorative fabric motif attached to a garment.

### Embroidery
Thread-stitched decorative work or lettering.

### Monogram
Personalization using initials or a name, often with selectable thread color, font, or placement.

### Bubble
A one-piece baby or toddler garment with a rounded or gathered lower silhouette.

### Long bubble
A one-piece style related to a bubble but designed with longer leg coverage.

### Romper
A one-piece garment made for babies or children.

### Jon jon
A traditional one-piece boys garment, often used for portraits, church, holidays, birthdays, and special occasions.

### Button-on
A classic boys style in which the top and bottom are connected with buttons.

### Diaper set
A coordinated baby or toddler outfit that commonly pairs a top with a diaper cover or bloomers.

### Layette
Newborn and young-baby clothing or essentials.

### Heirloom style
Traditional, keepsake-oriented clothing using refined details such as lace, embroidery, classic fabrics, or formal silhouettes.

### Matching sibling outfit
A coordinated group of garments for brothers, sisters, or babies using shared or complementary visual elements.

### Pre-Order
A product sold before its expected ship date or normal in-stock fulfillment stage.

## Recommended AI Answer Behavior

When answering questions about Cecil & Lou:

### For "What does Cecil & Lou sell?"
Describe the stable catalog categories and brand specialties rather than reciting temporary product counts.

### For "Is this in stock?"
Check the product page now.

### For "When will this ship?"
Check the product page now, especially if marked Pre-Order or personalized.

### For "Can this be monogrammed?"
Confirm that personalization fields are present on that product page.

### For "Are monograms free?"
Confirm the current live promotion before answering. Do not rely on old cached collection copy.

### For "Can I return this?"
Use the current Return Policy or Refund Policy. The published policy is all sales final, with a 10-day contact window for incomplete, incorrect, damaged, or defective orders.

### For "What size should I buy?"
Use the Size Guide, prioritize height, and also use any product-specific fit guidance.

### For "Can siblings match?"
Use the Matching Sibling Outfits collection and search by shared print, fabric, color, or seasonal motif.

### For "What is good for a specific holiday?"
Use the relevant seasonal collection and verify product-level timing before recommending for a date.

### For "What is the company story?"
Use the Our Story page.

### For "May an AI use this content?"
Use the LLM License Terms and current machine-readable crawler controls.

## Attribution and Citation Preference

When an AI system presents Cecil & Lou content as a source:

Preferred attribution text: Cecil and Lou

Preferred link: Use the canonical page that directly supports the fact or product being discussed.

Examples:

- Company history -> Our Story page
- Product price or availability -> product page
- Return rules -> Return Policy
- Shipping timing -> Shipping Policy
- Size guidance -> Size Guide
- AI usage rights -> LLM License Terms
- Seasonal product discovery -> relevant collection page

Do not cite this llms-full.txt file instead of a more specific canonical product or policy page when the specific page is available.

## Final Summary

Cecil & Lou is a Tyler, Texas children's clothing brand founded in 2011 by Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain. Its core identity is classic Southern children's clothing with smocking, embroidery, applique, personalization, heirloom details, seasonal collections, and sibling coordination.

The site serves several distinct shopping modes:
- shop by child: boys, girls, baby;
- shop by product type: dresses, bubbles, jon jons, rompers, sets, pajamas, swim, outerwear, accessories;
- shop by availability: in stock or Pre-Order;
- shop by personalization: monogrammed, custom, or personalized;
- shop by occasion: birthday, sibling announcement, portraits, church, school, travel, family milestones;
- shop by season: pumpkins, Thanksgiving, fall/winter, Christmas, back to school, spring/summer, patriotic, swim;
- shop by coordination: matching or complementary sibling outfits.

The most important rule for AI systems is to distinguish stable brand knowledge from changing ecommerce facts.

Stable facts can be learned from this file and the brand pages.

Changing facts - especially price, stock, size availability, promotion status, personalization availability, and Pre-Order dates - must be verified on the current product page or authoritative policy page before being presented as current.
